home.features_title: Duk abin da kuke bukata don samun nasara

home.cta_description: Kasance tare da dubun-dubatar manoman da ke amfani da FarmBuddy don inganta amfanin gonar su.
home.footer_description: Karfafa manoman kanana a Najeriya da fasahar AI.

features.ai_advice_desc: Samun amsoshi nan take ga tambayoyin nomanku daga mashawarcin noman mu mai basira.

features.pest_control_desc: Gano da sarrafa kwari yadda ya kamata tare da hanyoyin magance su na AI.
